established: Separate auxiliary signature domain and seven strict request/reply payload schemas
Exact externally supplied static delegation scope, purpose, role and payload digest
Candidate genesis/advance vs selected namespace unions without circular adoption requirements
Pinned manager/controller signatures and phase/profile/bootstrap/case correspondence
Canonical chunk bytes and result/use receipt correspondence
limitations: No RPC server, sockets, peer credential observation, live pin or nonce replay state
No production service deployment, independent Anchor or authority handoff reservation protocol
Deployment evidence is synthetic; required-precondition labels are not protected native OS events
Service credential-set digest remains an independently supplied opaque Enrollment reference, not a decoded service key registry
No multi-frame transfer assembler, full authority verifier, persistence or changed default reader
CN01–CN42 native conditions are unimplemented; existing C0/C1/C2 tests do not establish them

cases: request credential / instance / boot / epoch binding
reply server credential / instance / boot / epoch binding
stale listener digest after inode / device / FD replacement

signerContract: Independent pin carries full identity and request/reply direction
Request peer and reply server must equal the pinned credential, role, instance, boot and key epoch
Matching body and grant never substitute for the independently pinned signer identity
Unbound legacy pin shapes are rejected
listenerContract: Domain-separated hash of role / instance / boot and the full canonical sorted server-owned endpoint inventory
Every nonroot phase must match the recomputed inventory hash before bootstrap comparison
An empty inventory is identity-bound for clients without listeners
Updating inventory requires a new matching phase / bootstrap digest; an unchanged deployment profile does not authorize a stale digest

contextContract: ReadContext requests bind only the six grant-pinned lineage fields; a full mutable binding is rejected
The reply binding is observed: selection, revocation epoch, registry incarnation and provider boot may advance
The reply must keep the requested lineage fields and the existing exact Anchor record/revision pairing
An optional caller floor rejects a control revision, selection revision or revocation epoch older than last observed
All other auxiliary APIs still require the full current binding
completionContract: AbandonEnrollment (operator to registry, enrollment.abandon) binds one exact provision, the original BeginEnrollment operation/request digest and registry incarnation, with a provision-mode binding
Its reply binds the same provision, a retired registry record and the uninitialized phase; expiry and undecided-activation checks remain registry runtime work (C3b)
Read budget profile fixes every read phase, margin of at least 10% of the lease, total plus margin within the 5 s lease and closure within the C0 limit
Declared transfer and verify phases must cover the profile closure at the declared minimum rates; an over-budget closure is refused before any pin
The static runner accepts CN41/CN42 case conditions and rejects undefined CN43

beforeFix.note: includes fixture-shape failures of existing ReadContext role/acceptance cases and the fingerprint sync test
